evidence.reason: `_timer_schedule_seconds` parses only `OnCalendar`, `OnUnitActiveSec`/`OnUnitInactiveSec`, and `AccuracySec`, then returns `max(intervals) + accuracy`. It never reads `Timer/RandomizedDelaySec`, so a timer template declaring that systemd delay still gets a bound excluding the possible random delay. The function itself neither accounts for nor refuses the directive; without relying on the validator allegation, this is an ordinary correctness bug in the existing bound calculation. The smallest fix is to include `RandomizedDelaySec` in the bound or return no bound/refuse such timers.
